spots.name: Kuskulana Bridge
spots.tip: A landmark bridge: try blue hour when the lights come on, or low side light that shows the structure.

spots.name: Kenny Lake
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 119 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L754091.

spots.name: Edgerton Overlook
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint facing north. Side light at either end of the day. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: Cheshnina Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt.

spots.name: Liberty Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt.

spots.name: Tonsina River Overlook
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint. Check which way it faces: east for sunrise, west for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.
